```{r}
pacman::p_load(tidyverse, sf, sfdep, tmap, plotly, Kendall)
```

read in data

```{r}
hunan <- st_read(dsn = "data/geospatial",
                 layer="hunan")
```

```{r}
GDPPC <- read_csv("data/aspatial/hunan_GDPPC.csv")
```

```{r}
GDPPC <- left_join(hunan, GDPPC)
```

create time series cube

```{r}
GDPPC_st <- spacetime(GDPPC, hunan, 
                      .loc_col="County",
                      .time_col="Year")
```

```{r}
is_spacetime_cube(GDPPC_st)
```

Deriving spatial weights

```{r}
GDPPC_nb <- GDPPC_st %>%
  mutate(nb=st_contiguity(geometry),
         wt=st_weights(nb, 
                       style="W"),
         .before=1 #place any new columns created at the very beginning of the data frame.
  )
  
```

```{r}
gi_stars <- GDPPC_nb%>%
  group_by(Year)%>%
  mutate(gi_star=local_gstar_perm(
    GDPPC, nb, wt))%>%
  tidyr::unnest(gi_star)
```

Mann-Kendall test

H~0~: No monotonic trend present

H~1~: Monotonic trend detected

\`\`{r}

cbg=gi\_
